impressions.text: The task added provider-based usage and cost tracking, with cost rolled up to the originating issue and surfaced in reports; the worker reported 52 files and 865 tests passing after the final integration.
The delivery addressed review catches for migration dry-run output and integration with intervening changes, with regression tests and checks reported after those changes.
Work paused first for provider-capture guidance and later for a dependency merge; the owner also requested model prices, which were added before the final review submission.
